reason: I've never heard of this store and I'm about to put $360 into a fixture I can't see in person, with an electrician to schedule around it. Nothing here tells me the specs or the UL listing, so I'd go with a brand I know.
objection: I can't judge the quality from photos, and the store is unknown to me. If it shows up looking cheap or the wrong size, I'm stuck paying return shipping on a big boxed pendant, and I might wait 6 weeks to find out.
would_change_my_mind: A full spec sheet with exact dimensions, lumens, color temperature and a UL listing, plus real customer photos and reviews, and free return shipping or a cheap sample of the material.
